MetricQuantiles.description:
Quantiles over the samples where the metric is defined (R38: None margins skipped).

All three are None when no sample defined the metric; ``defined_samples`` says how
many samples contributed.

MissionRunManifest.description:
Replay manifest (architecture 19.9). Re-exported by app.schemas.evidence.

Versions are plain strings so an imported run made with a different engine /
catalogue version stays representable and can be flagged "not identical replay".
